appraisal_events.evidence: À la garde ! à la garde !... c'est bien par là que devait finir Swann. Joli milieu !
appraisal_events.explanation: The grandfather comically predicts and censures Swann's descent by association with the Verdurin milieu, though the narrator's exaggerated comic framing of the outburst leaves the verdict lightly undercut.

appraisal_events.evidence: sur la réponse négative de mon grand-père, c'est Odette qui avait amené elle-même Swann chez les Verdurin... le jour où Swann y fit ses débuts
appraisal_events.explanation: Where the family declines to help, Odette succeeds in bringing Swann into the Verdurin circle herself, marking his crossing into that milieu.

appraisal_events.evidence: Le docteur Cottard ne savait jamais d'une façon certaine de quel ton il devait répondre... on y voyait flotter perpétuellement une incertitude où se lisait la question qu'il n'osait pas poser
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator dwells on Cottard's chronic social uncertainty, his hedging conditional smile deployed everywhere from salons to the street, portraying him as unable to trust his own footing.

status_effects.explanation: The grandfather's disapproving prediction casts Swann as having let himself fall into a disreputable milieu, somewhat lowering him even if the tone is partly comic.
Swann crosses from outside to inside the Verdurin salon, making his debut there through Odette after the family's own channel was refused.
Cottard is portrayed as perpetually unsure of himself in social exchange, undercutting his standing through a sustained comic character sketch.

ambiguities: The grandfather's tirade against Swann is comically exaggerated, so it is unclear whether the narrator endorses it as a genuine judgment or presents it as parental fussiness to be discounted.
